liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds this Eyes extremely fast, to a degree they dislike; Reviewer agrees Eyes is overly speedy, calling it a mess and hard to listen to [21][23]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds Morning Dew inspired, though occasionally tiresome, with every lick played precisely; Attendee singles out Morning Dew as especially sick [14][19]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer calls Jerry's playing spot-on and thinks this may be the year's best Sugaree [13]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): After the jam, Bobby screams and the mix acts as if faded, giving his voice an eerie echo [14]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer recommends hearing Space on headphones [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-22.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105993.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 134 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds big, fat and juicy; Charlie Miller's work on it is praised as just right [16]
- **gd85-11-22.sbd.barbella.9709.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 130 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Jerry's vocals are weaker than earlier in the fall, but his guitar playing makes up for it [12]
- **gd1985-11-22.135608.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 130 min [5]
- **gd1985-11-22.135607.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 130 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended; this was the third night of a run, after two great nights, and the band rose to the challenge [17]
- Attendee recalls an extremely energetic crowd, Jerry sizzling and Phil in combat mode, dropping bombs [19]
- This was the third of three consecutive nights at Kaiser [20]
- Reviewer has heard nearly all of 1985 on the archive and ranks this Sugaree highest of that year [13]
- Show typifies 1985's spacey, meandering jams [14]
- Reviewer thinks this recording has the best sound quality of the three-night run [17]
- Per DeadBase search, the Cassidy> Dupree's> Let It Grow sequence occurs only at this show [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-22.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105993.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90) [1]
- **gd85-11-22.sbd.barbella.9709.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > ? > Dat > CDR [2]. Also: Master soundboard cassette, then an unknown step, to DAT, then CDR; seeded to etree by Steve Barbella [2]
- **gd1985-11-22.135608.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shnid=105993) Recording Info:SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90); Transfer Info:Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1)… [5]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user as a DTS surround recording for audio CD; FLAC conversion in May 2016 [5]
- **gd1985-11-22.135607.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16; Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=105993) Recording Info:SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell XLIIS-90); Transfer Info:Cassette Master… [6]. Also: Matrix mix of two sources, about 47% soundboard and 53% audience, made by an archive.org user [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1985-11-21 Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-11-21-henry-j-kaiser-convention-center-oakland-ca-usa/) [25]
